findings.truth: In the biology spec only the detection and identification of plant diseases is (HT only). findings.claim: Sweep of all ten lessons for combined-science exam wording.
findings.truth: Clean. No lesson names an exam board, states a paper count, a duration or a mark total, or tells a student a topic is 'separate science only' or 'not on your course'. Paper 1 covers topics 1 to 4, which matches this unit.
findings.evidence: grep over raw/L01-L10 for combined, trilogy, separate science, board names, paper and mark claims; spec 2.2 Assessments (Paper 1, topics 1 to 4, 1 hour 45, 100 marks, 50%, Foundation and Higher).

summary: Three required-practical numbers still followed the combined list and were renumbered to the biology list (osmosis 2 to 3, amylase 4 to 5, photosynthesis 5 to 6). Lesson 9 used a higher-only wrapper to mean 'separate science only': it is now scoped to the detection and identification of plant diseases, the only (HT only) part, and twelve '(Higher)' flashcard labels on core content were dropped. Lesson 10's wrapper is genuinely HT only and was kept. No combined-science exam-structure claims and no board names remain.
